title: PublicationManifest
description: Canonical durable publication manifest for one recording session, written last per plan section 9.1 write-ordering contract. Only a manifest that fully validates against this schema AND passes ADR-DATA-001 signature verification may enter the network catalog (plan invariant 6.1 #8).

x-ylx-versioning.rule: Consumers MUST fail closed (reject, do not guess) on any schema_version not in known_major_versions, or on any missing required field for the matching major version, even though additionalProperties is true. Unknown *additional* properties beyond this schema for a KNOWN schema_version are a minor/optional extension and MUST be ignored. This dual rule is enforced by application logic, not by JSON Schema alone -- see capture/tests/contract_w0_05/test_unknown_fields.py and ADR-PROTO-001.

schema_version.description: Manifest major version. v1 is frozen per F3; a breaking change bumps this and is a new major, never a silent v1 mutation (plan 12.1 F3).

session_id.description: Opaque stable session identifier. Never a filesystem path; used only as an opaque lookup key by CompletedSessionRepository (plan 8.4).

revision.description: sha256 of the canonical file inventory (canonicalize_manifest() with publication_signature removed, see ADR-DATA-001). Used for If-Match / ETag / disk-generation fencing (plan 6.1 #9, #11).

captured_at.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp of capture_durable milestone (plan section 5.1).

published_at.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp of the published milestone (plan section 5.1); always >= captured_at.

duration_seconds.description: Authoritative final duration from native/mux outcome, not the frozen STOPPING UI elapsed timer (plan section 5.2).

total_bytes.description: Sum of files[].size_bytes at publish time.

video_bytes.description: Subset of total_bytes attributable to video role files.

integrity_ok.description: True only when every files[] hash was recomputed and matched at publish time. This field alone is NOT an authenticity guarantee (plan invariant 6.1 #8) -- see publication_signature.

id.description: Opaque file id. The HTTP layer resolves this id to a real fd via dirfd/openat allowlist (ADR-PATH-001); it never receives or joins display_path itself.

display_path.description: Display-only relative path for UI/audit. MUST NOT contain '..' segments, NUL, backslash, a leading '/', a drive letter, or a UNC prefix. This field is advisory display metadata; ADR-PATH-001 forbids ever resolving it directly to an open() call.

key_version.description: Monotonic version of the persistent device publication signing key (ADR-SEC-002/DATA-001 rotation contract).

public_key_fingerprint.description: sha256 of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key. This fingerprint is also bound into the pairing SAS transcript (ADR-SEC-002).
